# DigMyName

> Smart domain search across 50+ TLDs with instant availability checks and registrar price comparison.

DigMyName helps users find available domain names quickly, with real-time availability checks and side-by-side pricing across multiple registrars.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search domain names across 50+ TLDs with instant availability checks and AI-powered name suggestions.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Compare domain registration, renewal, and transfer prices across major registrars.
- [Favorites](/favorites): View saved domains (requires sign-in).
